subject.title: [Feature Request] Session List: Show timestamp + last message preview

question: Should the narrow Control UI Sessions-list timestamp and preview land independently, be repaired through the existing implementation PR, or be folded into the broader sessions overview design work?
rationale: The technical path is clear, but the visible table design overlaps with broader open session overview, title, sorting, and peek requests, so maintainer UX scope should come before a new automated fix PR.

options.title: Land the narrow preview
options.body: Review or replace the existing implementation with a focused patch that requests includeLastMessage and renders a bounded preview in the current Sessions table.

options.title: Fold into broader overview
options.body: Keep this linked to the broader sessions-overview direction and close or pause narrow preview PRs once the canonical design issue is named.

options.title: Defer preview display
options.body: Leave the Sessions table as a technical management view for now and close related preview PRs with a maintainer-stated UX rationale.

recommendation.title: Land the narrow preview
recommendation.body: Review or replace the existing implementation with a focused patch that requests includeLastMessage and renders a bounded preview in the current Sessions table.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on the current Sessions UI and adjacent preview/session-list surfaces.
